newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal says no demand for 4-day certs.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal says no demand for 4-day certs.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal said there was no demand at its offer to drain money market liquidity with four-day certificates at a fixed rate of 6.2 percent.
"Only the Bank of Portugal can stop a sudden slide in the escudo (against the mark)," said a dealer who asked not to be identified.
Another said: "Only the Bank of Portugal can stop the drop in the escudo by buying escudos around 99.95 per mark."
Bank of Portugal spokesmen were not immediately available.
